locator.section: Latin/Tempora/Epi5-0.txt [Lectio], marker 19 and reference 20; inherited Latin/Tempora/Epi1-0.txt [Lectio], marker 32, title 33, reference 34 and complete body 35

entries.claim: The source key refers to the Holy Family Epistle. The inherited body has 108 words and ends per ipsum; its seven word-level accidental differences and the complete closing-span variant are recorded.
Benziger 1962 page 415 prints the complete 111-word Epistle for the resumed Fifth Sunday after Epiphany, including per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum. Its punctuation controls this transcript.
